summary: First Merchants Corporation filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for a $100 million offering of 6.750% fixed-to-floating rate subordinated notes due 2036. The notes pay 6.750% semi-annually through October 1, 2031, then convert to Three-Month Term SOFR plus 202 basis points, paid quarterly. The notes are unsecured subordinated obligations, rank pari passu with existing subordinated debt, and are callable from October 1, 2031, subject to Federal Reserve approval. Underwriting discount is 1.25%, yielding $98.75 million in proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
